title: A tree in a field
text: A combobox whose popup is a Tree View: type to filter, Down Arrow to move into the tree.

title: One or many
text: Single choice closes on selection; multiple choice uses tri-state checkboxes and removable tags.

title: Lazy hierarchies
text: Children load on expansion; labels of unloaded values come from valueLabels.

title: A real form control
text: Required validation, Form integration, a clear button, and hidden inputs for native submission.
